_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley Dialogue-Kent.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Japanese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "japanese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, reading, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "japanese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

AcceptGift_(O)Book_Bombs.japanese: ドワーフ語は読めないが、コレクションにするにはおもしろい。ありがとう。
AcceptGift_(O)Book_Bombs.english: Although I can't read Dwarvish, it's interesting as a collection. Thank you.

AcceptGift_(O)StardropTea.japanese: オレのために？予想外だな…だが決して悪い気はしない。ありがとう！
AcceptGift_(O)StardropTea.english: For me? That's unexpected... But I don't feel bad at all. Thank you!

Fri.japanese: 今日は 釣りに うってつけの 日だな。
Fri.english: Today is a perfect day for fishing.

Fri4.japanese: オレも釣りを始めるかな。ひまを持て余すぐらいなら、手を動かした方がいいだろう。
Fri4.english: Maybe I should start fishing too. If I'm going to have too much free time, it's better to keep my hands busy.

GreenRain_2.japanese: そうだな…雨は天の恵みだ。人間の想像をこえる大きな力が世界には存在するのだと教えてくれる。#$e#人はそれに感謝すべきなんだよ、@。
GreenRain_2.english: That's right... Rain is a blessing from heaven. It teaches us that there's a great power in the world beyond human imagination. People should be grateful for that, @.

Mon.japanese: やあ、牧場主さん。#$e#長いこと 留守にしてたおかげで…オレも よそ者みたいな 気分だ。
Mon.english: Hey, farmer. Thanks to being away so long... I too feel like an outsider.

Mon4.japanese: ようやく 家に 帰ってきたが、 馴染めるか 不安だな。#$e#この町の 平和は 仮初めみたいな 感じがする。オレの 思い違いかも 知れないが。
Mon4.english: I've finally come back home, but I'm anxious about whether I can fit in. This town's peace feels like a temporary facade. Though it might just be my misunderstanding.

MovieInvitation.japanese: ああ… わかったよ。ありがとう。映画館で会おう。$h
MovieInvitation.english: Ah... okay. Thank you. Let's meet at the movie theater.

Resort.japanese: ボートに乗るのは楽しかった。航海訓練は、船の操縦を手伝うのには役に立ったよ。$h
Resort.english: Riding the boat was fun. My naval training was useful for helping steer the ship.

Resort_Bar.japanese: 水を飲んでいるだけだよ。

Resort_Chair.japanese: 家族の絆を深めるにはもってこいの場所だ。あれを修理してくれて本当にありがとう。
Resort_Chair.english: This is the perfect place to deepen family bonds. Thank you really for fixing that up.

Resort_Entering.japanese: やあ、@。会えてうれしいよ。
Resort_Entering.english: Hey, @. I'm glad to see you.

Resort_Shore.japanese: この浜辺に立って...めずらしく安らぎを感じてる。$h#$e#海は特別なものなんだ。
Resort_Shore.english: Standing on this beach... I feel an unusually rare peace. The ocean is a special thing.

Sat.japanese: あんたが この町に 馴染めていると ジョディから 聞いたぞ。とても良いことだ。
Sat.english: I heard from Jodi that you've fit into this town. That's a really good thing.

Sat8.japanese: なかなか寝付けなくてな、 疲れているように 見えていたらすまない。#$e#あんたなら 分かってくれるだろう。
Sat8.english: I have a hard time falling asleep lately, so sorry if I seem tired. You'd understand, right.

Sun.japanese: うちに 戻ってきたのは いいが、 何を すべきか…#$e#今まで、 決められたことを する生活を 送ってたからな。
Sun.english: It's good that I've come back home, but what should I do... Until now I've been living a life of doing what was decided for me.

Sun4.japanese: あんたにはいそがしい日課があるんだろう？それはいいことだ。#$e#自由すぎると息苦しくなる。オレたちはみんな、人生に何らかの構造を築きながら前に進んでいるんだ。
Sun4.english: You have a busy daily routine, right? That's a good thing. Too much freedom becomes stifling. All of us are moving forward while building some kind of structure in life.

Thu.japanese: 息子とは 友達か？#$e#もしかしたら、 オレより多く あいつのことを 知っていそうだな…$s
Thu.english: Are you friends with my son? Maybe you seem to know more about him than I do...

Thu6.japanese: #$1 Kent1#朝4時に 目を覚ますんだが… 日常生活に 戻れるか 時々 不安に 思える時がある。$k#$e#見ない間に、 サムは ずいぶん 成長したな。今では立派な 男だ。#$e#あいつの そばに いてやれれば 良かったな。$s
Thu6.english: I wake up at 4 in the morning... sometimes I feel anxious about whether I can get back to normal life. Without seeing him, Sam has grown up so much. Now he's a fine man. I wish I could have been by his side.

segments.gloss: if I could have been (for him)

Thu_inlaw_Sam.japanese: よう、 @。結婚生活は 楽しめているか？
Thu_inlaw_Sam.english: Hey, @. Are you enjoying married life?

Tue.japanese: オレが 出てから、 ここは たいして 変わっていないな。#$e#あんたが 来たこと 以外は。
Tue.english: Since I left, this place hasn't changed much. Except that you came.

Tue2.japanese: オレが 出てから、 ここは たいして 変わっていないな。#$e#新しい 農場主が 来たこと 以外は。$h
Tue2.english: Since I left, this place hasn't changed much. Except that a new farmer came.

Tue6.japanese: ずいぶん落ち着きを取り戻したと思っている。町に友人がいることはいいことだ。$h
Tue6.english: I think I've regained quite a lot of composure. Having a friend in town is a good thing.

Wed.japanese: あんたが ここに きて 結構な 時間が たったか？牧場は かなり 賑わってるだろうな。
Wed.english: Has it been quite a while since you came here? Your farm must be quite lively.

Wed10.japanese: 生きるということは特別な贈り物だ。だがそれは、またたく間に過ぎ去っていく… それを忘れてはいけない。
Wed10.english: Living is a special gift. But it passes by in the blink of an eye... You must not forget that.

segments.gloss: in the blink of an eye

Wed6.japanese: …戦地で 多くの 友を 失った。$s#$e#あいつらの 顔を 思い出せないから 尚更 辛いもんだ。#$e#…
Wed6.english: ...I lost many friends on the battlefield. It's all the more painful because I can't remember their faces...

accept_864.japanese: …！$4#$b#…どこで見つけたんだい？$4#$b#…$5#$b#コイツは…オレ達はあの戦争で一緒に戦ったんだ、@。オレにとって、アイツは兄弟みたいなものだったよ。#$b#でも…帰ってきたのはオレだけだった。$5#$b#アイツは勇気を失わなかったよ。たとえ死に直面しても。本当の英雄さ…オレはアイツの事を決して忘れない。#$b#これを持ってきてくれてありがとう…オレにとっては大きな意味を持つものなんだ。#$b#これを持って行ってくれ。食器棚の奥に何年も前からあったんだが、誰も使ったことがないんだ。
accept_864.english: ...! ...Where did you find this? ... This guy... he and I fought together in that war, @. To me, he was like a brother. But... I was the only one who came back. He never lost his courage. Even facing death. A true hero... I will never forget him. Thank you for bringing me this... it means a great deal to me. Please take this. It has been at the back of the cupboard for years, but nobody has ever used it.

segments.kana: ちょくめん しても
もって いってくれ
なんねん も まえ

eventSeen_100_memory_oneday.japanese: この間はすまなかった。#$e#オレは特別扱いを望んでいない。他のみんなと同じように普通の人間になりたいだけなんだ。
eventSeen_100_memory_oneday.english: Sorry about the other day. I don't want any special treatment. I just want to become an ordinary person like everyone else.

event_popcorn1.japanese: 黙ってろ！そうやって、 妻に オレを 責めさせるな。$u
event_popcorn1.english: Shut up! Don't make my wife blame me like that.

event_popcorn2.japanese: …$s#$b#まったく あんたの 言うとおりだな、@。$s

event_popcorn3.japanese: ウソをつくな！オレは 何よりも ウソが 嫌いだ！$u
event_popcorn3.english: Don't lie! I hate lies more than anything!

married_Sam.japanese: 息子が一人前になるのを見るのは父親の誇りだ。心から祝福するよ。$h
married_Sam.english: Seeing my son become a full-fledged adult is a father's pride. I congratulate you from the bottom of my heart.

reject_865.japanese: ああ…密閉されているから、味はしっかりしているはずだ。
reject_865.english: Ah... since it's tightly sealed, the flavor should be strong.
